# FinancialChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasFinancialChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasFinancialChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasFinancialChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasFinancialChart.h"`

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFinancialChartElement> CreateFinancialChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFinancialChartElement> CreateFinancialChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<FinancialChartDataVector> data, const std::string& title = "");   // Helper factory for financial chart with data
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasFinancialChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
